title: Content-addressed package blob store shared across installs
question: Store package blobs by digest in a single local store so an identical blob referenced by several versions or collections is stored once, with reference counting that makes deletion safe, and with verification on read.
answer: tools/marketplace/blob_store.py stores blobs at objects/<aa>/<rest> keyed by sha256(content). Two puts of identical bytes produce one directory-listed object file and two named refs in index.json. get() re-hashes and raises CorruptedBlobError instead of serving a mutated object. delete() of a still-referenced digest raises ReferencedBlobError. Refcounts are persisted in index.json (atomic tmp+replace) and re-derived after dropping the live BlobStore instance.

layer_boundary.this_unit: package blob bytes + on-disk refcount + verify-on-read
not_this_unit: IMP-0040 plugin cache (runtime artefacts, different layer)
IMP-0084 lockfile digest enforcement at install

implementation.refcount_source: index.json on disk, not process memory
implementation.delete_policy: refuse while any named ref remains
implementation.read_policy: recompute sha256; mismatch is CorruptedBlobError, not served
